name: xo
description: XO operator workflow system for Cortex Code: composable workflow stages with quality gates, specialised subagents (proposer/critic/verifier), behavioural-enforcement hooks (automatic session recording, context checkpointing, and process guidance), and persistent cross-session memory. Prereqs: node, git (gh only to create a GitHub-backed vault). After install, run the bundled setup.sh at the plugin root (Windows: setup.ps1) to check node is reachable by hooks and optionally choose or create a git-backed vault (it also registers the plugin when installed from a git clone); then restart Cortex Code and Connect and Trust the xo-ops MCP server in the MCP panel.
